about: Frozen 2026-11-10, written AFTER the Motor Vehicles Act word-pass patterns were frozen (mv_detect_questions.json was the development set). Run ONCE, no tuning afterwards. Written by Claude (not a lawyer).
positives: My client is a 41-year-old truck driver. Around 11 pm on a highway his truck hit a man who was crossing the road, and the man died. My client did not stop and drove on.
Our school van met with an accident and three children were hurt; the driver says the brakes failed. What are the owner's responsibilities?
A drunk man was driving the tractor when it overturned and killed a labourer.
The police stopped my bike and asked for papers; I had only a photocopy of my licence.
Is there a cashless treatment scheme for the first hour after a road crash?
I run a goods carrier business. Do I need a fitness certificate and a permit for every truck?
The traffic police are checking people for using mobile phones while riding. What is the fine?
A cyclist died when the tipper reversed over him; the tipper owner has no insurance.
The insurer says my policy lapsed a week before the crash and rejects the claim of the injured pedestrian.
What happens if a minor is found driving a scooter and causes an injury?
A speeding car crashed into the divider; the driver was intoxicated and two passengers died.
Our bus was overcrowded and the driver was fined for carrying passengers beyond capacity.
The family of the deceased in a road accident wants to know how much time they have to apply to the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal.
Can the RTO cancel my driving licence for repeated traffic violations?
A speeding tempo hit a boy near the school gate; the driver stopped for a moment and then left. The boy died.
My vehicle was impounded for plying without a permit; how do I get it released?
negatives: The accused attacked the shopkeeper with a rod and fled with the cash.
My husband beats me and his family demands dowry.
The truck was stolen from the depot and the watchman is suspected.
A person posted an obscene video of his ex-girlfriend on social media.
The company owner cheated investors of Rs 5 crore through a fake scheme.
My client is accused of bribing a clerk at the sub-registrar's office.
A man set fire to his neighbour's house during a dispute.
The police registered an FIR against my client under the NDPS Act for a small quantity of ganja found in his car.
The bus conductor and the passenger quarrelled over change and the conductor slapped him.
A woman was thrown out of her matrimonial home and is seeking maintenance.
The accused took a taxi and robbed the driver at knife point.
The tenant has damaged the house and the landlord wants him evicted.
My client has been summoned for a cheque bounce case of Rs 3 lakh.
A doctor operated without consent and the patient died; the family wants to file a case.
The accused is alleged to have hacked the company's server and stolen data.
He drove his friend to the police station to file a complaint against the landlord.
